description: This Java class models the <entity-data-reader> XML element, providing methods to access its name attribute and associated resource list, and includes constructors for initialization from a name or an XML element.

classes.name: EntityDataReader
classes.description: A class representing the <entity-data-reader> XML element, encapsulating its name and resource list.

methods.name: EntityDataReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a name, throws exception if name is null or empty.

methods.name: EntityDataReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing from an XML Element, extracting name and resource list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name attribute of the entity data reader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of Resource objects associated with this entity data reader.
